items.title: D-St set for a positive opening as GIFT Nifty signals firm start
items.description: On Thursday, market indices Nifty and Sensex experienced notable advances, illustrating a surge in local investor confidence. The Nifty surpassed the 23,000 mark, buoyed by strong domestic demand and robust tax revenue. Experts predict that the market may undergo a period of consolidation amid recovery efforts and selling pressures. While foreign portfolio investors engaged in net selling, domestic institutions stepped up as net buyers.

items.title: Stocks in news: RIL, Wipro, Jio Financial, Tata Communications, YES Bank, PNB
items.description: From a technical perspective, the 23,000–23,100 zone remains an immediate resistance level for the Nifty, according to Ponmudi R, CEO of Enrich Money. A sustained breakout above this range could reinforce bullish momentum and open the door for a move towards 23,300–23,400, he said.

items.title: IT stocks power Dalal Street rally as global AI trade loses steam
items.description: The rally came even as concerns over sticky US inflation and the prospect of further monetary tightening weighed on global markets, triggering a sell-off in technology stocks across Asia, particularly in South Korea and Taiwan.

items.title: SC ruling deals a heavy blow to Yes Bank's risk equity capital
items.description: Yes Bank is facing a significant reduction in its Common Equity Tier-1 capital buffer following a recent Supreme Court ruling. The court reversed the earlier write-down of over $800 million related to additional Tier-1 bonds. Analysts suggest that this verdict could lower Yes Bank's CET1 ratio to approximately 11-11.5%. The bank is currently analyzing the judgment to assess the final impacts on its financial standing.

items.title: India's current account deficit narrows to $5.2 billion in August as capital account surplus hits $50.6 billion
items.description: India's current account deficit narrowed to $5.2 billion in August, compared to $6.1 billion a year earlier. The capital account surplus increased substantially to $50.6 billion, influenced by non-resident deposits of $83 billion. The balance of payments showed a surplus of $45.4 billion, contrasting with a deficit of $5.6 billion in the previous year. External commercial borrowing saw a net outflow of $22.4 billion during this time.

items.title: India insurance regulator to oversee smooth transition to new commission rules, chairman says
items.description: India's insurance regulator, the IRDAI, plans to implement reforms for insurance sales to improve the market. Proposed changes include capping commissions and tightening expense limits to reduce costs and mis-selling. Ajay Seth stated the intention is to avoid disruption within the industry during this transition period. Insurers and distributors have expressed concerns regarding the potential impacts on business models and job security.

items.title: Indian Bank reports a Rs 1,388 crore gain from sale of NSE shares
items.description: Indian Bank gained Rs 1,388 crore from the NSE listing, boosting second-quarter non-interest income by 50% to Rs 3,953 crore. The one-time gain offset pressure from rising bond yields, despite Rs 123 crore in mark-to-market losses. Meanwhile, Canara Bank and UCO Bank reported declines in other income, reflecting weaker treasury earnings.

items.title: Jio IPO GMP at 20%: Grey market signals Rs 220 premium as brokerages say subscribe
items.description: Jio Platforms’ Rs 30,200 crore IPO has a grey market premium of Rs 220 ahead of its October 21 opening. Emkay Global and SBI Securities highlight its telecom leadership, earnings growth and digital expansion, while flagging valuation, regulatory and capital expenditure risks.

items.title: HFCL’s AI, data centre exposure drives Nuvama’s Buy call; target implies 56% upside
items.description: Nuvama has initiated coverage on HFCL with a ‘Buy’ rating and a target price of Rs 380, implying a 56% upside from its reference price of Rs 244. The brokerage expects the company’s shift towards telecom and networking products, along with rising demand from data centres and exports, to drive earnings growth.

items.title: Indonesia’s $1.5 trillion market faces a historic downgrade: Why global investors are worried
items.description: Indonesia’s $1.5 trillion stock market plunged after MSCI warned that its emerging-market classification may no longer be appropriate, raising fears of billions of dollars in foreign outflows. Concerns over market transparency, opaque shareholding structures and policy credibility have intensified investor anxiety, with Indonesian equities down nearly 40% in 2026.

items.title: PC Jeweller, Shanti Gold & other jewellery stocks rally up to 10%. Here's why
items.description: Jewellery stocks, including Shanti Gold International, PC Jeweller and Sky Gold and Diamonds, rose sharply on Friday as mutual fund houses temporarily restricted fresh subscriptions to gold ETF Fund of Funds. With the festive and wedding season approaching, analysts expect resilient gold demand, while organised retailers could benefit from market share gains.

items.title: Persistent Systems shares slide 5% despite Q2 revenue growth. Buy, sell or hold?
items.description: Persistent Systems shares fell 5% despite 7.8% sequential constant-currency revenue growth in Q2FY27, as margin contraction and a sharp decline in profit weighed on sentiment. Brokerages remained divided on the stock amid valuation concerns and acquisition-related costs.

items.title: Bulls fight back as Sensex stages 700-point comeback. 4 factors driving the rally
items.description: On Friday morning, benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty made a remarkable recovery after a short dip into negative territory. The IT sector continued its upward trend for the fourth consecutive session, with significant contributions from industry leaders such as Tech Mahindra and Infosys, which surged, boosting the sectoral index. While a few companies faced declines, the general market outlook remained optimistic, following a notable rise earlier in the week.

items.title: New CAS rules decoded: What Sebi’s revised framework means for stock market traders
items.description: Sebi has revised the Closing Auction Session (CAS) framework after receiving more than 20,000 comments from stakeholders. The updated rules introduce a 10-minute closing auction, restore the VWAP method for F&O expiry settlement prices and clarify order transfers. Most changes will take effect on December 7, 2026.

items.title: Karur Vysya Bank shares rally 6% after Q2 profit jumps 37% YoY
items.description: Karur Vysya Bank shares rose sharply after the private sector lender reported a 37% year-on-year rise in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 788 crore. Net interest income grew 19% to Rs 1,497.3 crore, while total business increased nearly 18% to Rs 2.40 lakh crore.

items.title: Beyond Titan and Kalyan: Analysts pick these jewellery stocks as potential market winners. Do you own any?
items.description: As the festive season approaches, India's gems and jewellery sector braces itself for an influx of consumer demand. Analysts believe that sustained purchases tied to weddings could boost sales, even amid rising gold prices. While Titan Company and Kalyan Jewellers remain prominent, Senco Gold and Lalithaa Jewellery Mart are capturing investor interest.

items.title: These large- and mid-cap stocks can give more than 20% return in 1 year, according to analysts
items.description: The next few weeks are critical, and one should not be in a hurry to make market-related decisions. Better to be cautious – to wait and watch. Let the picture become a little clearer before you act.

items.title: Wipro shares rise over 2% as Q2 revenue grows 9% YoY. What are Nomura, Goldman Sachs analysts saying?
items.description: Wipro reported a 9.1% year-on-year rise in Q2FY27 revenue to Rs 24,752.7 crore, while net profit fell 1.9% to Rs 3,201 crore. The IT major expects Q3 revenue growth of -1.5% to 0.5% sequentially in constant currency terms. Nomura retained its Buy rating with a Rs 200 target, citing a slight revenue beat and confidence in delayed large deals closing.

items.title: Jio IPO: Meta, Google sit on nearly ₹1 lakh crore paper profit & neither is selling
items.description: Meta Platforms and Google are poised to realize significant gains from their Jio investment made in 2020. To bolster its growth, Jio Platforms is moving forward with an initial public offering planned to raise around ₹30,213 crore, achieving a valuation of ₹10.3 lakh crore. Neither Meta nor Google plans to divest shares in this round as existing backers maintain their stakes.

items.title: India's Yes Bank AT-1 ruling won't impact ratings despite earnings hit, S&P says
items.description: Yes Bank faced a setback as India's Supreme Court overturned its write-off of 84 billion rupees in bonds. S&P Global Ratings stated the ruling would not impact its credit rating of the bank. The decision highlights procedural errors in the 2020 write-down process, which regulators had supported. Despite this ruling, Yes Bank is expected to maintain adequate capitalization in the future.

items.title: Tech Mahindra shares gain 5% after Q2 results. Should you buy, sell or hold the stock?
items.description: Tech Mahindra share price: Tech Mahindra shares rose after Q2FY27 net profit increased 32.7% year-on-year to Rs 1,586 crore. Nomura retained its Neutral rating, seeing limited upside despite expectations of above-peer growth in FY27, driven by large telecom deals and expansion across other verticals.

items.title: NSE, BSE, Groww, other capital market stocks rise up to 3% as Sebi revises CAS framework. What traders must know
items.description: SEBI has revised the Closing Auction Session framework, changing market timings, order transfer rules and settlement price calculations for derivatives. The updated rules will take effect from December 7, 2026, with provisions for transferring unexecuted limit and iceberg orders kicking in on February 8, 2027.

items.title: Market wrap: Tech Mahindra, TCS, InterGlobe, BSE top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Friday
items.description: Indian equities extended gains as strong IT earnings lifted sentiment, with the Nifty rising 149 points to 23,146 and Sensex gaining 413 points. Tech Mahindra led advances, while broader markets slipped. Analysts flagged 23,000 as crucial for further upside.

items.title: Laurus Labs shifts gears as CDMO emerges as key growth driver; Nuvama sees 24% upside
items.description: Nuvama Institutional Equities has initiated coverage on Laurus Labs with a ‘Buy’ rating and a target price of Rs 2,520, implying a 24% upside from the current market price. The brokerage expects the drugmaker’s shift from its traditional anti-retroviral (ARV) business towards contract development and manufacturing (CDMO) to drive its next phase of growth.

items.title: 10 stocks held by 100+ MF schemes in September rally up to 205% in CY26; 6 turn multibaggers
items.description: When a large number of mutual fund schemes invest in the same stock, it often indicates strong institutional interest and can boost retail investor confidence. As of September 2026, data show that 288 stocks were held by more than 100 mutual fund schemes, highlighting the extent of mutual fund participation across these companies.An ETMarkets analysis found that 50 of these stocks had gained more than 25% since the beginning of CY26. Among them, 10 stocks delivered returns ranging from 75% to 205% during the first nine-and-a-half months of the calendar year. Notably, six of these stocks more than doubled in value, emerging as multibaggers during the period. (Data Source: ACE MF, ACE Equity)

items.title: Mukesh Ambani taps massive Reliance workforce to boost Jio’s record IPO
items.description: Mukesh Ambani is mobilising Reliance Industries’ workforce to boost interest in Jio Platforms’ record IPO. The conglomerate has encouraged employees to consider investing, released October salaries early and set aside shares for eligible employees and Reliance shareholders.

items.title: From worst to best: How IT stocks staged a Rs 2.6 lakh crore revival this week
items.description: Indian IT stocks staged a sharp comeback this week, adding Rs 2.6 lakh crore in market value as the sector gained 12% to become the best-performing index. Better-than-expected Q2 earnings, positive management commentary and a selloff in AI-linked stocks helped revive sentiment, even as concerns over AI adoption and earnings growth persist.
